svg.text: Federated simulation architecture: DRAG / BR-DRAG with an optional DP layer
Single process, sequential clients, one GPU. [P1]-[P4] = owner. Blue = messages crossing the client/server boundary.
YAML config -> build components via registry -> run rounds -> checkpoint / resume -> sweep
Every stage is optional. With all of them off, the upload goes straight to the server.
Honest path: 1 -> 2. Update-level attackers skip 1, 2 and go to 3.
Label-flip attackers use the honest path on poisoned data.
Audit tap: truth labels, norms, cosines. Stripped before the server.
BR-DRAG: r = SGD on root data
